from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single judgment document extracted from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action or legal classification stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
